item.title: Evangelical leaders rally for Trump and Israel as Operation Epic Fury reshapes the region
item.summary: Evangelical leaders say support for Israel has remained strong during Operation Epic Fury, the joint U.S.-Israel military campaign against Iran, as a new ceasefire takes hold.

item.title: Trump, Rubio face NATO chief as US moves to 'reexamine' alliance after Iran clash
item.summary: President Donald Trump to meet NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte at the White House as transatlantic tensions escalate over the U.S. military operation in Iran.

item.title: Gen Jack Keane 'skeptical' that Iran ceasefire will hold, warns Tehran will 'delay and obfuscate'
item.summary: Gen. Jack Keane says he is skeptical about the Iran ceasefire, warning Tehran has a track record of using negotiations to buy time and delay deals.

item.title: Hegseth declares 'decisive military victory' over Iran
item.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth says the U.S. military achieved an "overwhelming victory" in Iran after President Donald Trump agreed to a truce on Tuesday.

item.title: Biden ally tells Spanberger to exit ‘bunker’ as ex-gov renews debate push
item.summary: Former Biden aide says Virginia Gov. Spanberger squandered goodwill by ducking criticism, as ex-Gov. Allen renews his push for a redistricting debate.

item.title: 5 US House races shift toward Democrats: Cook Political Report
item.summary: Five House districts shift toward Democrats in new Cook Political Report analysis as the GOP and Democrats vie for control of the House during midterms.

item.title: Husband of American woman missing in the Bahamas speaks out for first time, says he is 'heartbroken'
item.summary: The husband of missing American woman Lynette Hooker speaks out, saying he is heartbroken after she reportedly fell overboard from a dinghy in the Bahamas.

item.title: Judge Boasberg weighs curbing Trump FTC demand for trans minors’ data after heated court clash
item.summary: The FTC in January launched an investigation into the medical groups providing transgender treatments for minors, which the groups argued is "retaliatory" and unconstitutional.

item.title: ‘Baywatch’ star Donna D’Errico went from homelessness to fame, admits ‘shame’
item.summary: Donna D'Errico opens up about experiencing homelessness before her Baywatch career and why she now volunteers serving meals at the LA Mission.

item.title: Resurfaced video shows Gavin Newsom's wife fearing young men 'moving to the right' online
item.summary: Jennifer Siebel Newsom, Gov. Gavin Newsom's wife, expressed concern that boys were moving more to the right by spending time online in a resurfaced video.
